features.quote: structural remains of large stones, and a plastered pool nearby

date.basis: pool not dated itself; entry only says the complex 'might have been' a Roman fortress

notes: Pool: the text gives no compass direction ('in the upper part' of the southern slope). Plan fig. 412 has a north arrow (pointing to upper left) and a 0-20 m bar but no grid, so the unit's recorded point (100 m precision) cannot be placed on it; position none. For the record, the plan puts the pool in the top (by the arrow roughly NE) part of the walled site, c. 50 m from the plan's centre. Cisterns: 3 is the data-block count, no position or date. No graves; no absence statements.
